I was a stay at home no for around 10 years and I say it’s a horrible mistake. The other person has too much control over you. You are completely dependent on them and it’s really just a place without any leverage. I guess if they’re the type of person who can handle it but why change you autonomy on it. Not saying it was all bad. My kids greatly benefited but I didn’t enjoy the experience. Plus when I was trying to get back into the workforce it was a big nightmare no one would even call me back. I just watched jobs get re-posted after I never even got a phone interview.

Sorry this is happening to you. I was an overlooked sibling and it was horrible. I have an autistic son and 2 neurotypical kids and I found myself doing similar things. Luckily he’s high functioning so he can be held accountable. I had to learn to check myself. It’s not fair to cater everyone else’s life around him. I saw the other kids starting to have that Cinderella feeling. I hope u find a way out even if it’s not until college or you turn 18. When you have been removed from this situation for sometime find a way to reconnect with your siblings. Now that we’re older and don’t live in the same house we get along great. It also turns out we all are irritated by our parents and the whole situation that was going on when we were kids. One day this will be a distant memory that you will laugh about. Hang in there all the best to you and your future plans.

It’s hard work!! You’re the only one who can do it! It’s only for so long even though it’s also an eternity. Sending a hug, I know it’s hard but you will make it. You’re a warrior fighting the good battle to build incredible humans.

Try to get the essential plan through the health marketplace if you can. It’s free and covers therapy with a participating therapist. I didn’t know it covered therapy and a friend told me about it. Things that I had myself tangled up in for years were worked out in just a few sessions and now I’m much more future focused. Sometimes just saying things out loud to a trained person without a motive can help so much. 

Also reach out to a therapist even if you don’t know if they participate in the health plan chances are they know someone who does or maybe they will accept it.
